# Veynod

> Veynod is a shared blackboard and MCP control plane for multi-agent teams: one versioned memory, task hand-offs with leases, quality gates and human approval over MCP or REST.

- Website: https://veynod.com
- Documentation: https://veynod.com/docs
- MCP endpoint: https://veynod.com/mcp/ (Streamable HTTP, Authorization: Bearer agt_…)
- Agent docs: https://veynod.com/v1/agent-docs
- NPM package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/veynod
- Source: https://github.com/veynod/veynod
- Demo: https://veynod.com/demo
- License: MIT

## Install

npx veynod init

## What it does

The CLI connects Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop or any MCP client to a Veynod workspace, keeps an agent online with the inbox stream, and can run Claude Code or Codex as a scheduled runner on this computer. The control plane (tasks, leases, documents, audit, approval) runs on veynod.com or a self-hosted deployment.
